transcript.text: dryer drum wont turn but i can here it running, hotpiont. clothes just sit there

1. Unplug the dryer and make sure it's empty.
2. Try to turn the drum slowly by hand. If it spins freely with no resistance at all (like a wheel on a bike), the belt is probably broken or off. If it feels stiff, hard to turn, or makes a grinding noise, something may be jammed in the drum support or bearings. Please let me know what you feel when turning it by hand.
ok unplugged and tried it, drum spins really easy almost no resistance at all

This is a very common failure on Hotpoint dryers. To confirm this and see if you can fix it yourself (it usually just involves fitting a new belt), you'll need to access the drum area. For most Hotpoint models, this means removing the top panel: unplug the machine, remove the two screws at the back of the top panel, slide the panel forward slightly, and lift the front up to tilt it back on its rear edge (don't let it fall). Look inside at the large drum; you should see a black rubber belt. Is the belt still there and whole, or is it broken/missing? If you are not comfortable opening the machine, this is a straightforward repair for an engineer, but the part itself is inexpensive.
ok will have a go, ive got screwdrivers. just had a look through the filter slot with a torch and i can see a black rubbery strip lying at the bottom, think thats the belt?

[Heading: Likely cause: drive belt]
To get you the correct replacement part, I need your model number. It’s usually on a sticker inside the door frame or on the back of the machine. Can you read it out for me? If you can't find it right now, that's fine—we can work with what we have.
[Panel: "To check a suitable replacement — Enter your model number below. Once we have the model I can check whether a suitable replacement is available. It's usually on a sticker inside the door or around the frame, or on the back of the appliance."]
the sticker is worn so i can only read the start, it says TVHM8 and the rest has rubbed off. will the panel steps still work to check the belt?

[Heading: Likely cause: drive belt]
Yes, those panel steps are correct for Hotpoint dryers in that series. Seeing a black rubbery strip at the bottom suggests the belt has snapped or slipped off. Because your model number is incomplete (TVHM8...), I cannot verify the exact part compatibility or give you a guaranteed fit from standard suppliers. Fitting a belt requires removing the front panel and routing it correctly around the drum, motor pulley, and tensioner; getting this wrong can cause damage or noise. I recommend calling an engineer. It is a standard repair, but having the exact part beforehand makes it much quicker and cheaper for them. If you can find the rest of the model number on the back of the machine or inside the door seal (often starting with W, T, or F), you might be able to order the belt yourself from a reputable spare parts site, but without the full code, an engineer is the safest route.
